svg.title: Rules of engagement: the signed document that authorizes and bounds the test
svg.desc: At the center is the RoE. Around it: scope with in-scope and out-of-scope IP lists, permitted dates and times, the testing team's source IP addresses, a single client monitor who can halt the test, permitted and forbidden techniques such as denial of service or social engineering, immediate reporting of critical findings, data handling, restoration after the test, and the approval signatures that make it lawful.
svg.text: Rules of engagement: the signed document that authorizes and bounds the test

g.text: Scope creep, testing beyond what was signed, is unauthorized access.
